name: relevance threshold >=7 (12x, 20->10)
description: Threshold arm of the relevance sweep. Identical to fresh_news_hold_winners.json except screened_corpus=tech_scored_ge7.csv and freqs=[12].
notes: PART OF A DOSE-RESPONSE SWEEP: >=7, >=6, >=4 (plus the existing binary
screen arm and the unscreened arm as reference points).
WHY A SWEEP AND NOT AN A/B: the earlier screened-vs-unscreened contrast
(-6.31pp, p=0.039) compared TWO DIFFERENT SELECTION MECHANISMS, not one
filter at two settings. screened=True reads tech_screened_corpus.csv with
NO keyword filter; screened=False reads the raw corpus WITH a literal
'technology' substring filter. Over a 24-month lookback those sets overlap
on only 13% of the screened corpus. That contrast cannot isolate relevance.
score_news_relevance.py rates all 13,183 articles 1-10 on one anchored
rubric, so threshold is the ONLY variable across these arms and the result
is a dose-response rather than an apples-to-oranges comparison.
corpus                articles   share   worst 90d window
binary screen         1799     13.6%      79
>=8                   1026      7.8%      43   <- EXCLUDED, fails gate
THIS ARM: >=7, 1572 articles, 11.9% of corpus, worst 90-day window 66.
>=8 IS DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED. Its thinnest decision sees 43 articles against
the min_articles=50 gate, so cells would be SKIPPED and the paired
comparison would silently break. Lowering the gate for that arm alone would
confound threshold with gate, so >=8 is simply out of the sweep.
GATE UNCHANGED at 50/90d, and _news_dates now measures the SAME corpus the
run reads, so the gate is honest for each arm.
COMPARE AGAINST: hold_winners @12x (binary screen, INIT 45.60%) and
unscreened_12x (raw corpus, INIT 51.91%). Read the INIT column - it is the
period-0 pick held, i.e. picks quality with the reinvestment layer removed.
CAVEAT FOR THE PAPER: the NHSJS precision figure (100%, Wilson 94.8-100%)
was measured on the BINARY prompt and does NOT transfer to this rubric. A
threshold sweep in the paper needs its own hand-labelled validation. Also
the scorer is gpt-4o-mini while the strategy runs on gpt-5.1.
9 windows x 3 runs = 27 runs. dry_run FALSE: this SPENDS BUDGET.
